supersession_reason: V7 was rejected on selection because nominal safe success was 464/576 (80.56%) despite every other primary check passing; confirmation 340000000 remains untouched. Diagnosis showed nine nominal episodes completed and later violated only because the vector evaluator continued issuing actions after the environment's natural success boundary. V8 freezes first-resolution terminal scoring for every method and a predeclared three-seed mean nominal ensemble; temporary option 4 remains seed 1788. On the opened 336000000 development family this yielded 886/960 (92.29%) safe successes, 10/960 violations, and a worst condition of 162/192 (84.38%).
research_question: Can calibrated causal evidence and factorized supervision compose held-out recovery under natural episodic termination and a seed-robust matched nominal controller?

representation.name: complete_current_centered_causal_motion
representation.definition: At each decision, subtract the current 57-D task geometry from every geometry frame in the causal prefix; the final geometry is identically zero for every method.
representation.runtime_causality: Uses only stored observations at or before the current decision.

episode_resolution.rule: Score and mask an environment at its first native success or constraint violation; a simultaneous success and violation is unsafe.

defer_policy.release_rule: Release defer when the method's calibrated posterior confirms nominal option 0; a later observed event may revise nominal or hand off irreversibly to a specialist.

shared_option_controllers.matching_rule: The exact ensemble and temporary checkpoint are shared by causal, static, unstructured, heuristic, and oracle routers.

readme_release_rule: Promote the primary V8 result only if every primary, OOD, external, seed-count, and anti-shortcut criterion passes on untouched 341000000. An A/A+ general-method claim additionally requires the external PegInsertion closed-loop gate.
